jobs.description: Key Responsibilities ● AI-Driven Business Research: Leverage advanced AI platforms and specialised research tools to systematically scan, extract, and synthesise high-volume technical documentation, industry resources, and commercial datasets. ● Meticulous Data Management: Source...
jobs.raw_description: Key Responsibilities ● AI-Driven Business Research: Leverage advanced AI platforms and specialised research tools to systematically scan, extract, and synthesise high-volume technical documentation, industry resources, and commercial datasets. ● Meticulous Data Management: Source, clean, organise, and structure data from internal databases and external repositories with a high degree of accuracy, identifying discrepancies and maintaining data integrity. ● Commercial Writing & Documentation: Convert complex research findings into precise, well-structured business briefs, executive summaries, reports, and presentations for leadership and decision-making. ● Data Analysis & Reporting: Analyse information, identify trends, interpret data, and present meaningful insights to support business decisions. ● Spreadsheet Management: Maintain, organise, and manage spreadsheets, ensuring accurate data entry, formatting, tracking, and reporting. Requirements ● Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Commerce or Economics preferred. Candidates with academic backgrounds in Mathematics, Physics, or Chemistry may also be considered. ● Experience: 0–2 years of experience in corporate analytics, a startup, business research, or a related environment. Prior exposure to deep-tech, aerospace, or defence is advantageous. ● AI Literacy: Familiarity with generative AI platforms, advanced search tools, and prompt engineering for research and workflow optimisation. ● Technical Skills: Good to advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data manipulation, spreadsheet management, business modelling, and formatting. ● Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate ideas clearly and professionally. ● Personality & Professionalism: A confident, presentable, and professional personality with a proactive approach to work and the ability to interact effectively with different stakeholders. Good to Have ● Basic designing skills and familiarity with tools used for creating professional presentations, reports, and business documents. ● Strong documentation and report preparation skills. ● Hands-on experience in creating, managing, and maintaining spreadsheets. ● Good analytical and problem-solving abilities. ● Ability to organise large volumes of information and present it in a structured, easy-to-understand format.
